findings.resolution: curriculum/v5/baseline.json pins program order as a prefix, graph rows and resource records per record, and unit/recall/artifact contracts by digest; check_v5 rejects any accepted identity change and replays the accepted route prefix.

findings.summary: Five fourth-edition acceptance receipts had no tracked producer script.
findings.resolution: run_unit_campaigns_v5, run_workflow_v5, record_review_v5 and run_release_guards_v5 produce machine_hosted_acceptance, firmware_integration_acceptance, workflow, review_delivery and release_guards with dict-shaped source pins.

findings.summary: cmastery init overwrote a family's own CONTRACTS.md with the generic component-contracts guide.
findings.resolution: The generic guide lands as COMPONENT-CONTRACTS.md when the family ships CONTRACTS.md; PROJECT.md links follow; check_learning_v4 covers both cases.

findings.summary: Published text carried glued word/number forms from pinned locators and 286 doubled list markers from unit checks.
findings.resolution: Render-time normalization in cmastery.text with matching expectations in check_html/check_markdown; the lints report zero remaining forms.
